episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her journey of using YouTube as a powerful lead generation tool, emphasizing the importance of consistency and patience. She discusses the challenges of starting a channel, the systems she implemented to manage leads, and how her persistence paid off with significant business growth.
